purpose: Canonical public proof contract. Live counts are not duplicated here so crawlers do not index stale numbers.

live_values_policy.reason: Visitor, order, and revenue numbers must come from live endpoints or dated evidence files.

drift_policy: Do not hardcode live visitor, order, or booked-revenue counts in static pages or this file.
A gate verdict is a policy decision, not an external-world outcome.
A broker receipt is not independent world-state proof.
A public compare page is not an invocable capability.

public_claim_boundaries.receipt: Records a broker-signed allow/execute/deny plus hashes. Not world-state proof.
public_claim_boundaries.health: GET /health version and buildSha. Not revenue.
public_claim_boundaries.compare_agoragentic: Agoragentic is an agent OS plus marketplace. ThumbGate is a coding-agent PreToolUse firewall. Adjacent, not a substitute.
